---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: a4
    margin:
      x: 2.5cm
      y: 2.5cm
    fontsize: 11pt
params:
  row: 1
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
#| output: asis
library(dplyr)

app <- readRDS("applications.rds") |>
  slice(params$row) |>
  select(-any_of(c("Email Address", "Full name", "Affiliation")))

# Escape all punctuation so that applicants' text is never parsed as markdown,
# and keep their paragraph breaks
format_answer <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || trimws(x) == "") {
    return("*No answer provided.*")
  }
  paragraphs <- trimws(strsplit(x, "\n+")[[1]])
  paste(gsub("([[:punct:]])", "\\\\\\1", paragraphs), collapse = "\n\n")
}

cat("# Application", sprintf("%03d", params$row), "\n\n")
cat("Submitted on", format(app$Timestamp, "%d %B %Y (%H:%M)"), "\n\n")

questions <- setdiff(names(app), "Timestamp")
is_declaration <- startsWith(questions, "I confirm")

for (q in questions[!is_declaration]) {
  # Drop the "(max N characters, including spaces):" instructions
  label <- sub("\\s*\\(max [^)]*\\):?\\s*$", "", q)
  cat(paste0("**", label, "**\n\n"))
  cat(format_answer(as.character(app[[q]])), "\n\n")
}

if (any(is_declaration)) {
  cat("## Declarations\n\n")
  for (q in questions[is_declaration]) {
    cat("- ", q, " **", app[[q]], "**\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
